C06 has a similar failed-request/renewed-request/encouragement sequence, while C10 parallels the appeal for private organizations to educate the public, but neither matches the child's specific subject as closely as C14.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I want to express my appreciation for your letter of November twentieth","parent_excerpt":"I appreciate your July fourteenth letter","explanation":"Both open by acknowledging and appreciating the recipient's recent letter."},{"child_excerpt":"the Administration's program for United States membership in the Organization for Trade Cooperation","parent_excerpt":"H.R. 5550 which would authorize U.S. membership in the Organization for Trade Cooperation","explanation":"The letters address precisely the same proposed U.S. membership, not merely a broad shared foreign-trade topic."},{"child_excerpt":"It is the intention of the Administration to renew its request to the coming Congress for such membership and to seek earnestly for affirmative action.","parent_excerpt":"I am pleased indeed to have your assurance that H.R. 5550 will be among the very first measures to be considered by your Committee next year.","explanation":"Both frame the membership proposal around affirmative congressional consideration in the next session."}]}
